gate.rule: activate a target finger only when the corresponding Shadow expert fingertip is within 20 mm of the object and the target fingertip remains more than 3 mm farther away

optimization.frame: Shadow expert grasp_frame with maximum source contact-tip count
optimization.joint_groups: only joints belonging to the activated semantic finger
optimization.temporal_application: ramp residual from close_start to grasp_frame and keep the constant residual afterward while preserving original frame-to-frame dynamics
optimization.joint_limits: bound the effective residual against every trajectory frame so physical commands never require post-hoc clipping

range_reason.0.05_rad: about 2.9 degrees, a conservative local contact correction
range_reason.0.10_rad: about 5.7 degrees, large enough to change fingertip clearance but much smaller than the earlier Linker all-finger squeeze of 0.425 rad
range_reason.no_larger_values: larger residuals make unsigned nearest-surface descent more likely to cross the intended contact surface and disturb already correct grasp geometry

difference_from_rejected_xhand_contact_r: does not jointly re-optimize the full wrist and all finger joints
does not force fingers that the Shadow expert did not use as contacts
does not freeze finger joints during lift
preserves the complete original trajectory and adds only a bounded constant residual after grasp
selection_rule: within each hand require success_count above the current A baseline and positive paired net gain; ties favor 0.05 rad; at most one global residual cap can enter D

linker.decision: reject both because success set is unchanged

xhand.decision: select only delta 0.10 for frozen D confirmation; evidence is directional but not statistically significant
